name: Go-Cart Solidworks Model
notes: Create a fully detailed Solidworks assembly of the go cart with every part and detail visible. Must utilize Solidworks best practices and high quality parametric modeling standards.

name: Fix IDEA-Morph Tail
notes: Restore the IDEA-Morph tail completely. Good as new and stronger than before.

name: IDEA Coin Launcher
notes: Build a handheld device that can accurately launch IDEA coins across the classroom.

name: Restore FRC Field Setup
notes:
-Line the carpet with gaffers tape to close seams and adhere outer perimeter
-Move and anchor all field elements to their original positions
-Replace any damaged April Tags
-Move the driver station tables back into place

name: Clean Print Lab
notes:
-Clean off all tables
-Empty all receptacles
-Sweep Floors
-Wipe down inside of printers and remove loose debris from inside printers and surroundings

name: Sweep IDEA Shop
notes:
-Dust off all table surfaces
-Sweep the entire IDEA shop floor (excluding carpets)

name: Rearrange IDEA Shop
notes:
-Move all loose items into proper storage locations
-Move all work tables into proper positions
